description: This file defines the 'AgentNodeRunner' struct and its methods for managing agent nodes, including launching processes, checking port availability, fetching capabilities, and updating registry metadata. It handles starting agent nodes, ensuring they are operational, and collecting their runtime info.

classes.name: AgentNodeRunner
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing the lifecycle of agent nodes, including launching, port management, and info updating.

methods.name: RunAgentNode
methods.description: Starts and manages an agent node, ensuring it is running and registered.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Finds an available port within predefined range 8001-8999.

methods.name: isPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available for use.

methods.name: startAgentNodeProcess
methods.description: Begins the agent node process with appropriate environment variables and logging.

methods.name: waitForAgentNode
methods.description: Waits until the agent node responds at its health check endpoint within a timeout.

methods.name: displayCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent node's reasoners and skills from its HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: updateRuntimeInfo
methods.description: Updates the registry YAML with current runtime info of the agent node.

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the registry file containing installed agent nodes.

methods.name: loadPackageEnvFile
methods.description: Reads environment variables from a package's `.env` file.
